note: Echo stills and motion clips with a blank screen (the face is drawn in code). frames: stills, with the screen box as fractions of the frame, and reach (the still's extent). clips: alpha-packed H.264 (colour above, alpha below), one keyframe, with the screen tracked per frame as [centre x, centre y, width, height, tilt degrees], and reach (everything the clip covers); optionally a face script ([share of the clip, face, gaze x, gaze y] from that point on), frames with a blink, and lens frames ([centre x, centre y, glass radius, scale, blink]: one big eye shows through a magnifier, through the glass band). sequences: steps (a still with face and hold in ms, 0 = rest forever, or a clip) played once, then an optional loop.
